acceptance: A scan of /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox.wt-*/.mcp.json finds no `todo-db` registration, or each remaining one is listed with the owner's reason to keep it.
description: Cleanup gap from the tractable switch (#4013, merged 2026-11-07). On 2026-11-11, 42 BenchBox.wt-* worktrees were still on branches cut before #4013: their .mcp.json registers `todo-db` through their pinned todo-db runtime and their copy of the todo skill tells agents to run bare `todo-db` CLI commands (bootstrap, validate, list). The global todo-db tool was uninstalled on 2026-11-11, so those bare commands now fail with command not found; the MCP server still works through each worktree's own pinned wheel. Work resumed in such a worktree also runs an old tracker version against the live store (schema 4 is compatible, but claim rules differ from 1.1.x). Each needs merging origin/develop if still live, or retiring through make worktree-finish. Related: worktree-reap-leaves-malformed-and-closed-pr-worktrees-20261112, which covers why the reaper cannot remove some of them.
